description: Plan a test case's fan-out across its runSettings records in one lane, for a caller that runs the records itself, such as a local run; it starts nothing and writes nothing. Response shape: { testCaseId, laneType, fanOutPolicy, fanOutChoice, isPrimaryKnownGood, isSecondaryGatedOnPrimary, records: [{ runSettingsId, resolutionLabel, displayResolution, isPrimary, testScriptId }], notRunRunSettingsIds }. `records` is in start order, primary first: run records[0] first. When isSecondaryGatedOnPrimary is true, run the rest only if that run passed, and otherwise report each as skipped because the primary failed; when false, run them all. A record's testScriptId is its script on the lane, absent when it has none: replay that script, or generate with the record's runSettingsId and displayResolution. Empty records means the lane has no records for the test case. notRunRunSettingsIds lists the records left unrun because fanOutChoice or the lane's fanOutPolicy is primaryOnly. Omit fanOutChoice to follow the lane's policy.

fanOutChoice.description: Optional: followPolicy (default) runs each test case's runSettings records per its lane's fan-out policy; primaryOnly runs only the primary record; allNow runs every record at once

runEnvironmentType.description: Lane to plan: 'local' (developer localhost) or 'remote' (deployed). A record belongs to one lane.

testCaseId.description: Test case ID whose fan-out to plan

name: muggle-remote-fan-out-plan
